summary: In Step 1, I tapped the 'Log In' button marked in red on the 'Welcome to Evia!' screen, which also displayed 'Get Started' and 'Explore as Guest' options below the central illustration. After the tap, the screen remained visually identical to the state before the action, showing the same welcome illustration, text, and button layout, and no new dialogs, navigation transitions, or input fields appeared to indicate a change in the application state.

In Step 2, I tapped the 'Email address' field and typed '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'; the screen transitioned to a login form where the email field now displays 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com'. Below the email field, a 'Password' field is visible with a hidden-text icon, followed by a 'Log in' button, a 'Continue with Google' option, and a 'Sign up' link. The on-screen keyboard is active at the bottom of the display, and the header reads 'Welcome back!' while the 'Forgot password?' link appears below the password field.

In Step 3, I tapped the 'Password' input field on the 'Welcome back!' login screen and typed the string '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'. Following this action, the password field displayed a series of masked characters ending in '9', while the email address 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' remained in the field above. The 'Log in' button, 'Forgot password?' link, and 'Continue with Google' button remained visible on the screen, and the on-screen keyboard stayed active at the bottom of the display.

In Step 4, I tapped the blue 'Log in' button marked in red on the login screen. Following the tap, the 'Log in' button transitioned to a greyed-out, disabled state, while the email address 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' and the masked password field remained visible in their respective input boxes. The on-screen keyboard remained open at the bottom of the display, and no further navigation, toast alerts, or error messages appeared on the screen.

In Step 5, I tapped the 'Log in' button marked in red on the login screen, which contained the email 'c4a30e8aa799a8a1@example.com' and a masked password. The screen transitioned to an event details page titled '[DEMO] Flutter và Firebase từ cơ bản', which displays '99 spots left', the organizer '[DEMO] CLB Công nghệ Evia', the date 'Nov 6, 2026', and the time '14:10'. The page also shows location details for '[DEMO] Phòng Lab A' and a blue 'Register Now' button at the bottom of the screen.

In Step 6, I pressed the 'BACK' key while viewing the event details for '[DEMO] Flutter và Firebase từ cơ bản'; the screen transitioned to the main 'Discover' tab. The interface now displays 'Hey EVIA E2E!' at the top, a balance of '200 coins', a search bar, and a featured event card for the same demo. Below this, a 'Recommended for You' section is visible, and the bottom navigation bar shows the 'Discover' tab as the currently selected item.

In Step 7, I tapped the 'Events' tab in the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'My Events' page, which displays 'Upcoming 0' and 'Past 0' toggles, a calendar view for 'Nov 2 – Nov 8, 2026', and a message stating 'No events on this date'. Below this, a 'Show all events ->' button is visible, and the 'Events' icon in the bottom navigation bar is now highlighted with a blue dot, indicating it is the active selection.

In Step 8, I tapped the 'Rewards' tab icon located in the bottom navigation bar, which was previously inactive. The screen transitioned from the 'My Events' view to the 'Rewards' page, which displays a 'Rewards' header at the top and several gray placeholder boxes representing content. The blue selection indicator moved from the 'Events' tab to the 'Rewards' tab, reflecting the navigation change within the application's bottom menu structure while the other tabs, 'Discover' and 'Profile', remained visible and unchanged.

In Step 9, I tapped the 'Profile' tab marked in red on the bottom navigation bar; the screen transitioned to the 'Profile' view, which displays the user name 'EVIA E2E', ID 'SE990001', and email '[REDACTED_TEST_SECRET]'. Below the 'Edit Profile' button, the screen lists 'YOUR ACTIVITY' sections including 'Saved Events', 'Following', and 'Notifications', followed by 'PREFERENCES & SUPPORT' sections for 'My Interests' and 'App Settings'. The 'Profile' icon in the bottom navigation bar is now highlighted with a blue dot, indicating it is the active tab.
